description: Smoke version of `linear_ring` (latex/notes/fct_experiment_plan.tex, sec:smoke, setting S1 at sigma^2 = 0), run end to end by tests/test_linear_ring_smoke.py. Ring of N = 16 hidden units, hidden kernel length_scale 2 sites (box = N = 16), P = 32 patterns; linear_teacher with m = n = 4 features, K = 2 latents uniform on [0, 1] and an orthonormal teacher; L = 1, phi id, g 1; k0 = k1 = 1 (input and output kernels of length_scale 0 and amplitude 1, weight_lambda 1); r = rate_lambda = 0; beta 0.25; SGLD, float64, CPU; every population on the deterministic grid. B = 256 members and one sample per member, its final state after 10^4 epochs: statistics are of the member-averaged final-state spectrum, with errors from the spread across members; the spectrum records (every 250 epochs) are only a burn-in diagnostic. Predicted by fct.linear_theory.predicted_spectra on the seed-0 data (whitened; the penalty's eigenvalue floor in brackets): q_1/2 = 1 for both modes, q = 0 shares 0.314 / 0.313, R(1)/R(0) 0.883 / 0.883 (0.880 / 0.879), power ratio of mode 1 to mode 2 over |q| <= 3 7.37; at beta 0.25 the data moves the spectra less than 1% from the prior, so this checks the sampler and the measurement, not the data term. The axes cross spatial.parametrisation [penalty, whitened] with train.lr [6e-4, 0.005], and the diagonal is the experiment: setting 0 (penalty, lr 6e-4) and setting 3 (whitened, lr 0.005), run with `exp run ROOT --index 0` and `--index 3`. Setting 1 (penalty at 0.005) is refused at run start by the penalty's step check; setting 2 (whitened at 6e-4) runs and shows the whitened result does not depend on lr. Each lr comes from its own run-start check. Penalty: lr k_max = 0.48, k_max = weight_lambda / (beta min_rel_eig lambda_0) = 798 the curvature of the floored modes (the check refuses lr k_max >= 2), which inflates their variance by 1.3x and moves R(1)/R(0) by 1.4e-3. Whitened: lr lambda_max(loss Hessian) = 0.03 (lambda_max = 6.1 at the prior initial state, the logged check value; refused at >= 1), a 1% inflation of every prior mode. min_rel_eig 1e-3 floors |q| >= 5 (lambda_q / lambda_0 <= 4.5e-4, a 3e-3 change in R(1)/R(0)) so that the penalty's softest data-carrying mode relaxes in about 2000 epochs; under the default 1e-6 the check would refuse any lr above 2.5e-6. Both parametrisations start from the prior (init prior, which whitened requires), so the first 2000 epochs suffice as burn-in. To change beta, set it with --set beta= and replace the lr pair with --axis 'train.lr=[...]' by the same two rules. At beta = 10 (S3) N = 16 is too small for the theory: SGLD gives mode 1 about half the predicted q = 0 power (0.72 of it at N = 64, 1.00 at N = 256).
